In the second group (gender comparison), the lowest value is 0, which corresponds to the "Много по-труден" (teal) category, not the "Малко по-труден" (purple) category, which has a value of 1.3.

In the third group (citizenship comparison), the lowest value is 1.2, which corresponds to the "Много по-труден" (teal) category, not the "Малко по-труден" (purple) category, which has a value of 7.5.
